title: Name the acceptance evaluation's record id as an id, not "hash", in show, show --full, next and the evaluate receipt
outcome: Name the acceptance evaluation's record id as an id, not "hash", in show, show --full, next and the evaluate receipt

The owner records a separate TermAl fallback-removal follow-up, ordered after Engram's removal. Interim additive output does not satisfy the final no-hash criterion.

Record ids, historical canonical receipts and evaluation contents are unchanged, and response fitting stays within its existing budget.
